Finite-index cochain transfer and degree-zero projection formula identify multiplicative norm with the coset product for nonnormal E/K.
Restriction H2 is surjective because its invariant is multiplication by d on Q/Z. The proof then uses cor res=d, with no illegal cancellation in Q/Z.
Reciprocity pairing and finite-character separation establish norm compatibility, with simultaneous convention inversion harmless.
Norms of units are units. Actual chi restriction has order at most two on units, so beta fourth power is trivial there. Logarithm depth and ramification bounds remain separate retained inputs.
